description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [High Quick Cast 2]/[Bushido Edge Mode] to the user if 0-3/4+ FF10 allies are alive

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Bushido Edge Mode
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 30% more damage, instant cast speed for Samurai abilities, casts Crushing Blaze after using three Samurai abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
